{{Quote|The ''Falcon'' is ours, sir. Her crew is on the run.|A pirate, informing [[Redkihl Rokk]] on the situation|<ref name="dsp" />}}
The '''battle of the ''Hungry Ghost''''' was a minor battle in [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] that took place aboard and around the ''[[Hungry Ghost]]'', the flagship of the [[Huralok]] [[Redkihl Rokk]] and his [[Redkihl Rokk's Pirates|pirates]], above [[Yavin Prime/Legends|Yavin Prime]]. The destruction of the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|first Death Star]], a planet-destroying superweapon, during the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] had left wreckage of the battle station. Redkihl Rokk and his pirates traveled to the wreckage to scavenge some of the Death Star's parts. However, [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]], the captain of one Rebel ship, the [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']], discovered the pirate ship but was attacked by Rokkk's [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|Red TIE Fighters]]. The pirates docked to the ''Millennium Falcon'', intending to take the [[Bomb/Legends|bombs]] the ''Falcon'' was carrying.

However, another Rebel, [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]], arrived in his starfighter and confronted the pirates, but his fighter was damaged in the ensuing battle. He managed to make it into the ''Hungry Ghost''{{'s}} hangar bay and ran through the ship, continually being chased by the pirates. Meanwhile, Rokk sent numerous [[Redkihl Rokk's spider droid|spider droids]] to scavenge the cargo of the disabled ''Millennium Falcon'', and the crew of the ''Falcon'' fought off the droids until the ship's power was restored. Solo threatened Rokk to detonate the bombs if the pirates didn't surrender. After engaging Rokk in combat and wounding the pirate, Skywalker escaped the ship through a hatch and fled to the ship. The ''Falcon'' broke free of the cables that held them to the ship and evaded laserfire from the ''Hungry Ghost''. Solo triggered the detonator, destroying the ''Hungry Ghost''.

==Prelude==
{{Quote|<nowiki></nowiki>''Millennium Falcon'', prepare to be boarded!|Redkihl Rokk, after disabling the ''Millennium Falcon''|<ref name="dsp" />}}
[[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]], a founding member of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]], was [[Rescue of Princess Leia/Legends|rescued]] from the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|Death Star]], the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire's]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]]-destroying [[Superweapon/Legends|superweapon]], by Alliance members [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]], [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]], and [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]], the latter two being [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]]. After her rescue, the [[Death Star plans/Legends|plans]] for the Death Star were found to be secured in [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]], an [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droid]] that Organa had previously hidden the plans in on her ship, the [[Tantive IV/Legends|''Tantive IV'']]. After analyzing the plans, the Alliance launched an [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|attack]] on the battle station, which had followed Organa back to the Rebel's [[Great Temple/Legends|secret base]] on [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]]. Although the Rebels were vastly outnumbered, Skywalker was able to destroy the superweapon with the help of Solo, which left an enormous amount of wreckage around Yavin,<ref name="anh">{{Film|IV}}</ref> and the Rebels evacuated their base before more Imperial troops arrived.<ref name="dsp" />

[[File:Reddy_reddy_red.jpg|thumb|left|150px|Redkihl Rokk contacts the ''Millennium Falcon''.]]
Skywalker, in his personal [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|X-wing starfighter]], jumped to [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]], headed for [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]]<ref name="dsp" /> to establish a [[Echo Base/Legends|new Rebel base]] in the system.<ref name="esb">{{Film|V}}</ref> Solo began to jump to hyperspace in his ship, the [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']], with [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]], his [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] copilot, as well as Organa and [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]], a [[Protocol droid/Legends|protocol droid]] under the ownership of Skywalker. Solo, however, scanned an unfamiliar ship in the Death Star wreckage. Assuming it could be Imperial [[Spy/Legends|spies]], Solo decided to investigate the unknown ship. Before they could find the ship, the ''Millennium Falcon'' was attacked by [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE Fighters]] that were painted red; their color scheme led the crew to believe that they were not of Imperial ownership. It was revealed that the unknown ship was in fact the ''[[Hungry Ghost]]'', a ship under the command of the Huralok scavenger Redkihl Rokk and his band of pirates, who had visited the wreckage to scavenge parts of the Death Star wreckage.<ref name="dsp" />

==The battle==
{{Quote|No escape for you, ''Millennium Falcon''!|Redkihl Rokk, believing he was victorious|<ref name="dsp" />}}
[[File:XWingDestroysRedTIEFighter.jpg|250px|thumb|Skywalker destroys a Red TIE Fighter.]]

Solo identified Rokk as a threat and tried to turn back, having heard rumors that Rokk gave his victims slow [[Death/Legends|deaths]]. The red TIE Fighters, however, hit the ''Millennium Falcon'' hard enough so that all power went out, and the ''Falcon'' was forced to dock to Rokk's ship. Rokk revealed that he planned to steal the ''Millennium Falcon''{{'s}} cargo, which consisted of bombs and other explosives. Immediately after the ''Millennium Falcon'' docked, Luke Skywalker emerged from hyperspace in his X-wing and destroyed one of the red TIE Fighters. After much confusion, the crew of the ''Millennium Falcon'' identified the X-wing as Skywalker's. Redkihl Rokk used twelve [[Laser cannon/Legends|laser cannons]] to disable the small [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]], but Skywalker managed to fly the damaged fighter into the [[Hangar/Legends|hangar bay]] of the ''Hungry Ghost.'' After being notified of Skywalker's survival, Rokk ordered the pirates to destroy Skywalker before he caused trouble.<ref name="dsp" />

Meanwhile, the pirates released hundreds of [[Redkihl Rokk's spider droid|spider droids]] to take the cargo aboard the ''Millennium Falcon''. Solo, Organa, and Chewbacca fought off some of the spider droids, almost hitting crucial parts of the ''Falcon'' in the process, but were unable to stop the droids from taking the cargo. After arguing about a plan for escape, Solo gave C-3PO a box with a [[Hologram/Legends|holographic]] message. C-3PO eventually encountered the Huralok captain and relayed the message. Solo told the captain through the message that he would detonate the bombs aboard the ship if he did not surrender and let the ''Millennium Falcon'' leave. Rokk, dismissing the smuggler's message as a mere bluff, told him to "do as you will." Their conversation was cut short by Skywalker, who had entered the bridge. Before Skywalker could attack, a laser turret behind Rokk fired and wounded Skywalker.<ref name="dsp" />

[[File:FalconEscapesRokk.jpg|thumb|left|150px|The ''Millennium Falcon'' escapes the ''Hungry Ghost'' by exploding it.]]

Rokk, threatening Skywalker with death, lunged at the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]]. Skywalker, however, used his [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] to rip some of the cables attached to Rokk that provided medicine for the Huralok. Rokk, enraged at the victorious Jedi, lunged at Skywalker again, urging him to come back and fight. Skywalker escaped through the hatch that led to the ''Millennium Falcon'', along with R2-D2, and Skywalker's protocol droid, C-3PO. After finding their way to the bridge, Organa embraced Skywalker now that he was safe, at least for the time being.<ref name="dsp" />

==Aftermath==
After Solo managed to get power back to the ''Millennium Falcon'', the ''Falcon'' broke away from the cables keeping it docked to the ''Hungry Ghost'', and the fleeing freighter dodged the laser blasts the pirates shot at it. The ship eventually traveled out of range, and Solo activated the detonator. The bombs exploded all around the ''Hungry Ghost''. Rokk and all of his pirates were killed in the explosion, and Rokk's ship was disabled. The ''Millennium Falcon'' then continued its planned course to Hoth.<ref name="dsp" />

==Behind the scenes==
The battle first appeared in the magazine [[Star Wars Kids (1997)|''Star Wars Kids'']], in the [[Star Wars comic books|comic]] "[[Death Star Pirates]]," written by [[Henry Gilroy]]. It appears over four issues of the magazine.<ref name="dsp" /> Later, the comic was published in ''[[Star Wars Tales Volume 2]]''.<ref name="swtv2">''[[Star Wars Tales Volume 2]]''</ref> Many details of the battle and characters are not revealed in the comic, such as the proper name for Rokk's ship or the species of Redkihl Rokk.<ref name="dsp" /> However, in the sourcebook ''[[Geonosis and the Outer Rim Worlds]]'', both the name of the ship and the species are explained.<ref name="gow">''[[Geonosis and the Outer Rim Worlds]]''</ref>
